text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: SLO_BREACH on /streaming/generate (us-west-2). p95=410ms (target 200ms), p99=1.9s (target 500ms). Error rate +0.4%. Paging eng-oncall.

taylor_oncall: oncall here — pulling traces. Seeing heavy tail on cont-batch path. Anyone seeing customer reports? @kai_support

kai_support: small number of streaming customers reporting stalls (video-captioning and live-translation). Opened CS ticket CS-7221 and notified account reps.

jamal_sre: grabbing traces now. Batcher logs show long enqueue times and frequent max-batch fills. Traces indicate mixed-length requests creating padding and head-of-line blocking.

sasha_runtime: yep. We got a traffic spike of long sequences from partner "omega-alpha" ~5x baseline. Scheduler is coalescing long+short into large padded batches; streaming requests wait for batch fill.

ryan_enginfra: infra check: nodes healthy, GPU mem fine, but batch_size histogram skewed to max (512) on some hosts. That aligns with jamal's traces.

maria_product: any sign it's model-internal? inference time per token higher?

sasha_runtime: model perf steady. This is scheduling/packing effect causing queue wait. Also noticing a few preemption events where background low-priority jobs grab slots.

taylor_oncall: quick mitigations? List them and quickest first.

sasha_runtime: fastest: reduce cont-batch.max_size to 128 for streaming queues. Next: enable experimental seqlen-aware packing flag (code flip, ~10-12m to rollout). Also we can route partner traffic to dedicated pool if they have capacity.

jamal_sre: reducing max_size is safest and fast. I'll prepare a config rollout.

ryan_enginfra: I'll apply config via ops-api. Command I will run:
```
curl -s -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/v1/configs \ 
  -d '{"cluster":"us-west-2","queue":"streaming","cont_batch.max_size":128}'
```
Will kick off hot reload across runtimes in ~45s.

taylor_oncall: do it. Announce when live.

ops-bot: Change requested by ryan_enginfra: cont_batch.max_size=128 for us-west-2/streaming. Rolling change in 45s.

ryan_enginfra: applied. hot-reload completed across 24 runtime pods.

sasha_runtime: batcher queue wait dropped immediately. p95 back to ~190ms within 90s.

kai_support: customers confirming improvement; stalls reduced.

maria_product: good. What about p99? We still need under 500ms.

jamal_sre: p99 improved but still at ~620ms. I see sporadic KV-cache misses and some preemption log entries where background ops forcibly reclaim GPUs.

sasha_runtime: we have a runtime flag preemptive_background=true. I can flip to false to prevent preemption of streaming-critical jobs. Quick patch:
```
opsctl config set runtime.preemptive_background false --cluster=us-west-2
```

taylor_oncall: apply it. Watch for backlog growth.

ryan_enginfra: applied preemptive_background=false. Monitoring queues.

jamal_sre: p99 trending down to 280-350ms now. p95 stable ~180ms.

kai_support: all affected customers on CS-7221 reporting UX restored. Marking as mitigated for now.

maria_product: what's the short-term cost impact from smaller batches and no preemption?

sasha_runtime: we expect slightly higher GPU cycles (more kernels) but it's temporary. We should move to seqlen-aware packing to regain efficiency once validated.

taylor_oncall: can we canary seqlen-pack quickly?

sasha_runtime: yes—deploy as queue-level feature to 10% of streaming traffic:
```
ops-sdk feature-toggle --name seqlen_pack --cluster us-west-2 --percent 10 --queue streaming
```
Starting canary now.

ops-bot: Feature toggle applied: seqlen_pack=10% on us-west-2/streaming.

sasha_runtime: initial canary feedback: canary nodes show reduced padding, cost down ~12%, p99 on canary=210ms. Need to validate for 10-15m to be confident.

jamal_sre: note: tracing sampling on canary is sparse; I'm enabling higher sampling for end-to-end verification.

ryan_enginfra: also created a temporary routing rule to send partner omega-alpha to a dedicated pool for 20m to prevent further mixed batches:
```
routectl apply --src=partner-omega-alpha --dest=dedicated-west-2 --duration=1200
```

kai_support: partner confirmed they were routed and their streaming jobs are stable.

maria_product: good. Let's capture follow-up actions.

taylor_oncall: action items:
- keep cont_batch.max_size=128 and preemptive_background=false until follow-up (owner: taylor_oncall)
- validate seqlen_pack canary and promote to 100% if stable (owner: sasha_runtime)
- add alert for sudden median_sequence_length increase >2x (owner: jamal_sre)
- evaluate autoscale/dedicated routing for partner spikes (owner: ryan_enginfra)
- customer comms for CS-7221 (owner: kai_support)

jamal_sre: collecting flamegraphs, perf counters, and batcher histograms for postmortem. Will attach to INC-3031-772.

taylor_oncall: created incident INC-3031-772, severity Sev-2. Logging timeline and mitigation steps.

sasha_runtime: suggestion for postmortem: add a runbook entry for "mixed seqlen padding amplification" and a quick rollback to max_size=128.

ryan_enginfra: I'll prepare autoscale playbook for sudden partner-induced long-seq surges and capacity isolation.

kai_support: drafting customer note and will run by product for approval.

maria_product: please include cost delta estimate for quarter and note mitigations so we can discuss in postmortem.

taylor_oncall: handing off to night oncall @leo_night in ~22m. Summary: batching-induced tail from mixed sequence lengths; mitigations applied (max_size=128, preemption disabled, partner routed to dedicated, canary seqlen_pack). Monitoring p95/p99.

leo_night: ack taking over. I'll keep current configs and will escalate if p99 > 500ms for 5 continuous minutes.

taylor_oncall: handing off. Incident in monitored state; CS-7221 and INC-3031-772 open. Thanks team :thumbsup:

leo_night: thanks. I'll keep eyes on dashboards and the routing rules. Good work everyone.
